Go to myaccount.google.com → Security
Turn on 2-Step Verification for your account.

In your Google Account, search for 'App Passwords'.
Select app: 'Other' → type 'CB POS' → Generate.

Copy it — you won't be able to see it again.

Paste the App Password as SMTP Password.

db_setup.demo_desc: Pre-loaded with 80+ products, customers, sample sales, and suppliers. Great for exploring the system.

backup_password.intro: One password protects all your backups — the ones you make, the automatic ones when you close the app, and the safety snapshot made before a restore. You'll need it to restore, even on a new computer.
backup_password.note_set: Write it down and keep it somewhere safe. If you lose it, nobody can open your backups — not even us.
backup_password.note_change: Only new backups will use the new password. Backups you already have still open with the password they were made with.
backup_password.too_short: The password needs at least {count} characters.
backup_password.save_failed: Couldn't save the password. Please try again.
